title: consider using anonymous namespaces for internal linkage
configure rstudio to automatically roxygenize
description: You can go to Project Options -> Build Tools and enable automatic roxygenize if you want to make sure this happens before check or building a source package (or even Build and Reload but that's probably overkill)

title: consider exposing c++ interface
use std::string for scalar strings
description: If you are expecting a single element character vector you can just use a std::string rather than CharacterVector

title: Use LinkingTo, not Depends for Rcpp
Use \donttest not \dontrun in examples
description: So you they're run if the user does `example()`, but are not run during R CMD check (I'm assuming they're not run because they take a long time)
